title: Nil Ɔkra a Wɔayɛ no Ayayade
intro: Wɔ nhyɛso kɛse bere mu no, bere a otirimɔdenfo bi de atirimɔdensɛm koraa dii asase no so no, ɔkra biako paw gyidi kwan sen ahemfo ahotɔ. Saa onipa yi traa tumi koma mu nanso onyaa nokware wɔ odiyifo bi a ɔbrɛ ne ho ase nkrasɛm mu. Ná wɔn akwantu no bɛyɛ asuade a enni bere mu wɔ boasetɔ, afɔrebɔ, ne gyidi a enhinhim ho. So wubetumi ahu onipa nwonwaso yi a na ɔpɛ ɔsoro anigye sen wiase gyinabea?
clues: Na mete ahemfie a tumi kɛse wom mu, nanso me koma nyaa nokware wɔ ahobrɛase nkrasɛm bi mu.
Mepaw sɛ medi Musa akwankyerɛ akyi, a na minim nea ebefi mu aba a mehyia.
Ná maware otirimɔdenfo a ɔwɔ tumi sen biara wɔ me bere so, nanso mepow n’atoro anyame no.
Na m’amanehunu no mu yɛ den, efisɛ wɔtwee m’aso esiane gyidi a na mewɔ wɔ Onyankopɔn Baako no mu nti.
Manhinhim wɔ me gyidi mu da, bere mpo a mihyiaa ayayade a emu yɛ den sen biara no.
M’Awurade ani gyee me boasetɔ ho na ɔpaw me maa beae a nidi wom wɔ Paradise.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
